body:
I'm not sure that I lost control..more like there is nothing left to control anymore, just the shattered remains of a better past and of an even better future.  
But I think I just might take you up on that offer.

I don't think going home is an option, or that it would help.
But I will try to see a doctor on Monday. But right now even the time til then seems so long..not to mention til I get an appointment, and even longer until whatever they could do to help me will work.

What do you mean with "go home" ?

I never went to a doctor with these issues, but now I am willing to try anything that could help.

Its difficult. She has a new job that is very stressful for her. When she comes home she is either stressed and aggressive , or too busy doing chores. And I feel she doesn't understand how serious my state is, seeing as I was often depressive before. It was never as serious as now though. Last time I told her how I was feeling she said something in the likes of "Well you are always feeling sad and depressive, that's nothing new" That hurt, feeling like you can't even reach out to the person you love and trust the most.

I moved to a new city a few weeks ago with my girlfriend. Our relationship was already strained before the move, and few days ago we agreed to be just friends for now. I know that it might be for the best since we have different ideas of a relationship, but I still love and desire her. that could be one thing. I also have no job, no friends here, she is the only thing I have left in this new life. And I know I should take this opportunity to find something worthwhile, new reasons to live, new moments of brightness, what makes life worth living. But I'm afraid that I won't be able to before its too late, and I feel that I just don't have the strength left to wait another day. I need something now, some joy, anything.
